items.headline: Three Epic veterans are building an AI-powered game engine to break the industry's doom cycle
items.excerpt: Amid mounting discontent with Unity and Unreal, ex-Epic engineers' new engine Immens promises lower costs and faster development for small teams. The pitch is an AI-native pipeline aimed at shrinking the production burden that keeps studios in boom-bust cycles.

items.headline: Rockstar formed a new LA-based team to develop more realistic NPCs for Grand Theft Auto 6
items.excerpt: Rockstar built a dedicated team to push NPC behaviour past Red Dead Redemption 2's 'level of interactive fidelity'. It's a hand-authored, systems-driven answer to the generative-NPC pitch the rest of the industry is selling.

items.headline: The Hollywood disruptors making a large-scale game with a 12-person team - and no generative AI
items.excerpt: Wolf Haus's co-founders explain how in-house tech - not generative AI - lets a dozen people build cult simulator Join Us at scale. A counter-case study to the 'AI shrinks your team' narrative.

items.headline: How Tripo Is Tackling Clean Topology for its 3D Asset Pipeline
items.excerpt: Tripo's chief scientist details Smart Mesh, which generates game-ready characters with usable topology in under 10 seconds. The pitch is closing the gap between AI-generated meshes and assets that survive a Maya/Blender production pipeline.

items.headline: We're finally talking about AI, ft. David 'Rez' Graham and Luke Dicken
items.excerpt: Two veteran game-AI programmers unpack what 'AI' actually means inside a game team, and where generative systems fit next to decades-old behaviour tech. A craft-level reset on a conversation usually dominated by hype.

items.headline: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
items.excerpt: DeepMind traces its games research lineage from Atari agents to work inside EVE Online, and what agents trained in live game worlds mean for design. Games remain the lab where agentic behaviour gets stress-tested.

items.headline: The Last of Us, Skyrim and More Get Unreal Makeovers With Nvidia's Controversial AI Tech
items.excerpt: PC players are running leaked DLSS 5 neural graphics over GTA: San Andreas and Skyrim, and the results are photoreal but uncanny. It's an early look at AI re-rendering overriding an art director's original intent.

items.headline: Modder Makes NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Work On GeForce RTX 40 Series Through A Simple CUDA Binaries Swap
items.excerpt: A CUDA binary swap gets DLSS 5's neural rendering running on last-gen RTX 40 cards ahead of release. If it holds, the install base for AI-rendered visuals widens far beyond NVIDIA's roadmap.

items.headline: Experimental Build Of Nvidia's DLSS 5 AI Slop Filter Leaks And Turns Beloved Video Game Characters Into Uncanny Valley Weirdos
items.excerpt: An experimental DLSS 5 build escaped into modders' hands and is re-skinning classic characters into uncanny near-photoreal versions. The leak reopens the question of who owns a game's visual style once AI post-processing ships.

items.headline: "Somebody will make the Half-Life 2 of AI" - Saber CCO on the Rideshare gen-AI controversy
items.excerpt: Saber's chief creative officer argues one genuinely great AI-built game would flip public sentiment overnight. It's the clearest statement yet of the 'prove it with craft' position inside a studio already under fire.

items.headline: No, the Humankind 2 announcement trailer wasn't made with gen-AI, despite it sharing a similar kind of look
items.excerpt: Amplitude had to publicly explain that its Gamescom trailer used real actors, practical sets and custom props. Suspicion has now reached the point where human-made work has to defend itself.

items.headline: After AI backlash, Assassin's Creed creator says 1666: Amsterdam "won't be using any AI anymore"
items.excerpt: Patrice Desilets says generative AI was only used in conception and pre-production, and the studio is dropping it entirely. Concept-phase AI is turning into a liability even when it never reaches the shipped build.

items.headline: Humankind 2 devs respond to "AI slop" accusations, assure fans its new Gamescom trailer features "real actors, practical sets, and custom-made props"
items.excerpt: Amplitude itemised the practical production behind its reveal trailer after players called it AI-generated. Studios now need a provenance story for human-made marketing art.

items.headline: id Software's former co-owner says they absolutely would've used gen AI back in the day
items.excerpt: An id Software co-founder argues the Doom-era team would have grabbed generative tools instantly, framing AI as continuous with the studio's tech-first culture. A useful counterweight to the 'real devs don't use AI' framing.

items.headline: Take-Two's former AI guy is, in a twist, skeptical about AI now
items.excerpt: The executive who led Take-Two's AI push now questions the vendors selling generative pipelines to studios. An insider's read on which promised gains actually show up in production.

items.headline: The bigwigs who want AI-generated NPCs and writing think you're too dumb to appreciate a good story
items.excerpt: A pointed argument that generative NPC dialogue substitutes volume for authored narrative craft. Aimed squarely at executives pitching infinite conversation as a feature.

items.headline: Saber Responds To AI Criticisms In Rideshare Game And Promises, "We Will Never Fire Someone And Replace Them With AI"
items.excerpt: Saber issued a formal position on generative AI after the Rideshare disclosure row, committing to no AI-for-headcount swaps. One of the first studio-level AI labour policies written under public pressure.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto 6 is "At Least 10 Years Ahead of the Industry" With NPCs, Says IOI's AI Programmer
items.excerpt: IO Interactive AI programmer Berkay Dursun says GTA 6 simulates every crowd character individually, putting it a decade ahead. A rival specialist's read on what non-generative game AI can still achieve.

items.headline: NPCAI just had an update - Check it out
items.excerpt: A hands-on walkthrough of the latest NPCAI update, showing how the LLM-driven NPC toolkit now behaves in a live game build. Useful for designers evaluating conversational NPC middleware.
